## PR Checklist

- [ ] I have read and agree to the **Individual or Entity CLA** (as applicable).  
- [ ] I certify that this contribution is **original**, written from public documentation and specifications.  
- [ ] No source code from another project was translated, ported, or adapted into this change.  
- [ ] I recorded any new redistributed dependency in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` with its licence and copyright line.  
- [ ] I described provenance below and included references (documentation, standards, papers).

### Provenance Statement
Describe how you created this contribution and which public documentation or
specifications you worked from.
